newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - MCI Communications lowered.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - MCI Communications lowered.

text.p: -- ABN AMRO Chicago Corp said Wednesday it downgraded MCI Communications Corp shares to hold from buy and revising its 1997 earnings estimate to $1.71 from $2.00.

-- The downgrade follows the proposed $20-billion merger of MCI with British Telecommunications Plc. ABN AMRO said MCI will become part of a new entity called Concert Plc once the deal closes, therefore a buy recommendation on MCI as a standalone company does not make sense going forward.
-- ABN AMRO added that MCI's stock performance has been "superb" and reaches its fundamental price target.
-- Its shares were trading up 1/8 Wednesday at 34-5/8.
